name: Agentic Coding Practices
description: A framework for engineering teams using AI coding tools at multiple autonomy levels (inner/middle/outer loop, based on Steve Yegge's model). Covers context rot, reward hijacking, and manager coaching guidance. Published internally as Agentic Coding Best Practices with skill levels 1-4 for the Claude Code rollout.

name: Change Data Capture
description: Track real-time data changes for sync and analytics.

name: Event Driven Architecture (Kafka)
description: Event-driven architecture (EDA) using Apache Kafka.

name: GeoJSON
description: RFC 7946 standard for encoding geographic data structures. Selected as the primary data format for ARCOS location services API — consumed natively by Mapbox, Leaflet, and OpenLayers with zero conversion. Used for both REST responses and SSE stream payloads.

name: Unified Cloud Testing (Mabl)
description: Mabl automated testing platform.

name: Expand Contract Pattern
description: Structured data migration pattern (pgroll, reshape). EB-284.

name: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
description: Unidirectional server-to-client streaming over HTTP, selected for next-generation location services real-time updates. SSE provides auto-reconnection, firewall-friendly HTTPS transport, and simpler architecture than WebSockets for the dispatcher use case where clients only receive updates.

name: Blue-Green Deployment
description: Zero-downtime deployment using parallel environments. EB-284.

name: FinOps
description: Cloud financial operations (CloudZero, CloudHealth).

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: Combine pretrained LLMs with domain knowledge retrieval.

name: .NET 8 Upgrade
description: .NET 8 LTS platform.

name: AWS Cognito
description: Amazon Cognito is the target identity platform for ARCOS/Lighthouse authentication. A two-pronged migration strategy is underway: Prong 1 adds SSO via external SAML 2.0 IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta) to the legacy system; Prong 2 consolidates duplicate multi-tenant user accounts into Cognito. Duke is the first real customer being onboarded via SSO in Iteration 5.

name: AWS Fargate (ECS .NET)
description: Managed container orchestration for .NET. EB-247.

name: AWS Lambda
description: Serverless compute.

name: AWS Verified Permissions (AVP)
description: AWS Verified Permissions provides externalized authorization using Cedar policy language. Being deployed in Iteration 5 for RBAC, establishing Crew Leader / Crew Member role boundaries as the foundation for location hierarchy and resource-level access control in Lighthouse.

name: Amazon ElastiCache
description: Managed in-memory data store.

name: AppSync Events
description: AWS real-time event-driven WebSocket communication. CO-7412, RAPD-15871.

name: EventBridge Pipes
description: Point-to-point event integrations. CO-7412.

name: Mapbox
description: Modern mapping platform selected to replace Esri for next-generation ARCOS location services. Architecture uses Mapbox Datasets API for real-time crew locations, Tilesets API for static infrastructure layers, and Mapbox GL JS for web rendering. SSE-based real-time updates with GeoJSON data format. Mapbox Documentation

name: AWS Athena
description: Serverless query service for S3 data lakes, used as the async export engine in the Reporting API architecture. Queries tenant-partitioned Parquet files on demand with pay-per-query pricing. Complements DynamoDB's hot serving layer for large-scale and ad-hoc report exports.

name: Kafka Connect
description: Integration of Kafka with external systems. EB-202.

name: RDS Proxy
description: Managed database proxy for RDS/Aurora. EB-218.

name: Apache Flink
description: Real-time stream and batch processing framework.

name: pgvector
description: Vector similarity search extension for PostgreSQL.

name: ESRI - ArcGIS
description: Esri ArcGIS is being superseded by Mapbox for next-generation location services. The high cost and complex licensing of Esri, combined with Mapbox's developer-friendly APIs and modern vector tile rendering, make Mapbox the preferred path forward. EB-285

name: Oracle RDBMS
description: Complex and costly licensing model.

name: WCF Web Services (SOAP)
description: Legacy, replaced by WebAPI REST.

name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's agentic coding CLI tool, replacing GitHub Copilot as the primary AI coding assistant across ARCOS Engineering. Claude Code supports unattended sessions, MCP server integrations, and is deployed on the Teams plan. Daily usage is expected of all engineers. Telemetry is being configured via OpenTelemetry with Splunk as the audit target.

name: CodeRabbit
description: AI-powered code review tool integrated into the PR workflow via Bitbucket. Configured for security-focused reviews. Actively measured through DX platform metrics for review cycle time reduction and rule coverage.

name: DX Platform
description: DX is the developer experience measurement platform used to track engineering metrics including DORA, AI tool adoption, developer satisfaction, and agentic coding usage across Codex, Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon Q, and CodeRabbit.

name: Docker
description: Container platform for app packaging and delivery.

name: LocalStack
description: Local AWS cloud emulator for dev/test.

name: Mermaid
description: Diagram generation from Markdown-like markup.

name: OpenAI Codex
description: OpenAI's agentic coding tool, available to ARCOS engineers via enterprise license. Positioned for well-defined, day-to-day coding tasks alongside Claude Code for complex and cross-cutting work. Part of a multi-tool AI coding strategy.

name: k6
description: JavaScript-based load testing tool selected over Gatling via ADR for its superior observability pipeline alignment (NFR #6) and native Datadog integration. Positioned as the standard performance test tool for ARCOS engineering.

name: Architecture Unit Tests
description: Verify architecture rules in code (ArchUnitNET). EB-283.

name: DuckDB
description: In-process SQL analytics database.

name: Ollama LLM Tool
description: Local LLM deployment and management.

name: OpenAPI
description: RESTful API design and documentation standard.

name: OpenTelemetry
description: Vendor-neutral observability framework being adopted for Claude Code telemetry and audit data collection. Target pipeline routes instrumentation data to Splunk for enterprise audit and compliance reporting.

name: AWS CodeArtifact
description: Artifact management, potential NuGet store for mono-repo breakup.

name: AWS Textract
description: ML-based document text/data extraction.

name: COTS Data Conversion Tools
description: flatfile.com, smartsheet.com.

name: GraalVM
description: Versatile high-performance runtime, native compilation, polyglot.

name: ProtoMaps
description: PMTiles single-file archive for serverless map tiles.

name: SQ Query Wrangling Tool
description: Lightweight SQL query wrangling for ad-hoc analysis.

name: pgroll
description: Safe reversible PostgreSQL schema migrations.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot is being deprecated across ARCOS Engineering in favor of Claude Code. Copilot access is being deactivated and is no longer recommended for new adoption. Teams should transition to Claude Code as their primary AI coding assistant.

name: AWS SAM
description: AWS Serverless Application Model framework.

name: AWS Step Functions - (Workflow Engine)

name: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
description: MCP is now a core integration pattern at ARCOS. The MCP Server is a production outcome in Iteration 5, moving from POC to production-hardened multi-tenant deployment with CI/CD, observability, and resilience patterns. MCP servers are in active use for ARCOS workforce data, Lighthouse, Atlassian, Slack, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

description: Modern frameworks for efficient cloud-native Java apps.

name: Server Side TypeScript
description: TypeScript on the server for robust backends.

description: Spring framework for AI engineering.

description: Framework for well-factored monoliths.

description: Google language powering Flutter.
